SELECT pr.id AS request_id, pr.request_number, pr.title, pr.status, applicant.display_name AS applicant_name, pr.department_id, COALESCE(pr.department_name_snapshot, department.name) AS department_name, COALESCE(pr.requested_supplier_name_snapshot, supplier.name) AS requested_supplier_name, COALESCE(item_summary.total_amount, 0)::BIGINT AS total_amount, pr.desired_delivery_date, pr.submitted_at, pr.version FROM purchase_requests pr JOIN users applicant ON applicant.id = pr.applicant_id JOIN departments department ON department.id = pr.department_id LEFT JOIN suppliers supplier ON supplier.id = pr.requested_supplier_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE( SUM( COALESCE(item.quantity, 0)::BIGINT * COALESCE(item.planned_unit_price, 0) ), 0 )::BIGINT AS total_amount FROM request_items item WHERE item.request_id = pr.id ) item_summary ON TRUE WHERE
ORDER BY pr.submitted_at DESC NULLS LAST, pr.id DESC
ORDER BY pr.desired_delivery_date ASC NULLS LAST, pr.submitted_at ASC, pr.id ASC
ORDER BY item_summary.total_amount DESC, pr.submitted_at ASC, pr.id ASC
ORDER BY pr.submitted_at ASC NULLS LAST, pr.id ASC
LIMIT #{criteria.limit} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_requests pr JOIN users applicant ON applicant.id = pr.applicant_id WHERE

SELECT department.id, department.name FROM approver_department_scopes scope JOIN departments department ON department.id = scope.department_id WHERE scope.user_id = #{approverId} AND department.active = TRUE ORDER BY department.code, department.id

SELECT pr.id AS request_id, pr.request_number, pr.status, pr.title, pr.reason, pr.desired_delivery_date, pr.requested_supplier_id, COALESCE(pr.requested_supplier_name_snapshot, supplier.name) AS requested_supplier_name, pr.note, pr.applicant_id, applicant.display_name AS applicant_name, pr.department_id, COALESCE(pr.department_name_snapshot, department.name) AS department_name, pr.version, pr.submitted_at, pr.created_at, pr.updated_at, decision.decision, decision.reason AS decision_reason, decided_by.display_name AS decided_by_name, decision.request_version AS decision_request_version, decision.decided_at FROM purchase_requests pr JOIN users applicant ON applicant.id = pr.applicant_id JOIN departments department ON department.id = pr.department_id LEFT JOIN suppliers supplier ON supplier.id = pr.requested_supplier_id LEFT JOIN request_approval_decisions decision ON decision.request_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN users decided_by ON decided_by.id = decision.approver_id WHERE pr.id = #{requestId} AND pr.status <> 'DRAFT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM approver_department_scopes scope WHERE scope.user_id = #{approverId} AND scope.department_id = pr.department_id )

SELECT item.line_number, item.product_name, item.model_number, item.product_url, item.category_id, category.name AS category_name, item.quantity, item.planned_unit_price FROM request_items item LEFT JOIN categories category ON category.id = item.category_id WHERE item.request_id = #{requestId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM purchase_requests pr JOIN approver_department_scopes scope ON scope.department_id = pr.department_id AND scope.user_id = #{approverId} WHERE pr.id = item.request_id ) ORDER BY item.line_number
